messages:
marta: FYI I'm opening a PR to rework the stream examples across Python/TS/Go so they match the new chunked iterator behavior. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210

lee: nice. What's changing exactly?

marta: main changes: SDK uses client.stream(...) that yields delta events; pagination param renamed to cursor; and Go needs explicit ctx cancellation in examples. Also want a short retry/backoff sample for 5xx when streaming.

omar: can we keep the old convenience snippet as a drop-in in a separate note? Some users still expect the single-response pattern.

marta: plan is to add a migration note and keep an "older SDK" snippet under a subheading. But default should be updated to iterator semantics.

lee: Python example idea:```py
buffer = []
async for ev in client.stream(req):
    if ev.kind == 'delta':
        buffer.append(ev.text)
result = ''.join(buffer)
```
callout: show how to handle stop signals and errors.

omar: Go sample:```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
defer cancel()
stream, err := client.Stream(ctx, req)
for {
    ev, err := stream.Recv()
    if err == io.EOF { break }
    if transient(err) { // backoff+retry }
    // handle ev
}
```
add note to import context and time.

lee: TS snippet:```ts
let out = ''
for await (const ev of client.stream(req)) {
  if (ev.type === 'delta') out += ev.text
}
```
mention Node version for for-await and polyfill options.

qa-bot: examples-check queued for PR 4210. lint: docs-lint passed, examples-sanity queued.

marta: also swapped page_token -> cursor in the paginate examples; double-check we didn't break the code samples for list APIs.

omar: double-checked TS and Python. Go still had page_token in one helper. I'll push a small commit to fix.

lee: added a tiny backoff util in the advanced patterns section that uses exponential jitter. Suggest link to internal retry policy.

marta: great. can someone plz confirm we added a migration blurb in breaking-changes.md explaining stream iterator and cursor rename?

omar: added the blurb + example diff. Pinged @support to update their runbooks.

docs-bot: PR opened: docs#4210  reviewers: @lee @omar @marta. CI: examples-sanity / docs-build queued.

marta: thanks all. I'll wait for CI then merge and publish a short note in the release changelog. If anything else, reply here. :slightly_smiling_face:
